title: The Echoing Hall
text: A great hall of black marble where every word comes back changed. Speak, and the walls answer in your voice with something that is almost what you said, and almost true. Each Scion who speaks here hears something about themselves they did not know.

options.label: Each Scion speaks their name into the hall, and hears what comes back.

outcomes.text: The echo says their name the way someone who loved them once said it. For a moment, that person is there.
The echo says their name the way their enemies will. They learn exactly how much they are hated.

options.label: Each Scion keeps silent, and listens to what the hall says of the others.

outcomes.text: They cross in silence, hearing everything the hall says of everyone else, and keep it to themselves.
